editorial.blurb: A hidden speakeasy tucked inside Moon Palace Express, Nine Bar crafts spirit-forward cocktails with Asian-inspired flair and shareable snacks that pair perfectly with their intimate, secret-club atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask specifically for Nine Bar when entering through Moon Palace Express, order the crab rangoons and loaded fries to share, and request Tim as your bartender if possible—reviewers rave about his craft.

topDishes.note: Incredible and strongly recommended by multiple reviewers
Pairs perfectly with cocktails, loved by hidden-gem discoverers
